statement: For each sector s, write the sector coframe as e_s = Lambda_s e_obs + L_xi_s e_obs + delta e_s^perp, where Lambda_s is local Lorentz, L_xi_s is diffeomorphism drag, and delta e_s^perp is orthogonal to q_obs gauge directions.
derivation: This is a local decomposition of the frame mismatch into gauge and non-gauge parts.
meaning: It separates harmless representation changes from a physical shadow frame.

statement: The metric shadow is h_s^perp_ab := delta g_s_ab - L_xi_s g_obs_ab after local Lorentz gauge is removed; local Lorentz rotations do not change g_obs.
derivation: delta g_s_ab = 2 eta_IJ e_obs_(a^I delta e_s,b)^J + O(delta e^2).
meaning: Only h_s^perp can produce a physical one-metric failure.

statement: If delta e_s is only local Lorentz plus diffeomorphism plus q_obs-kernel gauge, the EH density and descended source/readout actions change only by boundary/gauge terms.
derivation: delta_gauge L_EH = d(i_xi L_EH) and delta_Lorentz g=0; Dq_obs(E_A)=0 kills q_obs-owned readouts.
meaning: This proves the no-shadow route without smuggling a plateau axiom.

statement: If h_s^perp is nonzero, L_leak_shadow_g contains E_EH^{ab} h_s^perp_ab plus source/readout frame terms.
derivation: delta L_EH = E_EH^{ab} h_ab + d theta(h); source/readout pieces are delta S_src/dg_s times h_s^perp when the sector uses g_s.
meaning: This is the action-level residual corresponding to frame/source mismatch.

statement: If h_s^perp=0 for matter, EM, light, clock, and orbital/source sectors, then Delta q_matter, Delta q_EM, Delta q_light, Delta q_clock, and Delta q_orbit_source have no metric-frame part.
derivation: All sector frames factor through Obs_e(q_obs) up to gauge.
meaning: This closes the metric part of delta_frame_source conditionally.

statement: If h_s^perp is not zero, define epsilon_shadow_s := sup_U ||h_s^perp||_g and propagate it by delta_frame_source <= sum_s w_s epsilon_shadow_s plus nonmetric sector residuals.
derivation: Triangle inequality on the sector frame residual vector.
meaning: The failure branch is a residual vector, not a hidden closure assumption.
